headline: OpenRAC imports Deadlocked and adds tools to transfer code between projects
summary: OpenRAC adds Deadlocked's decompilation, build instructions and progress checking alongside source updates for the other games. New tools map related functions across games and transfer C between versions with the same instructions, checking the result with the destination project's tools. This is direct development on master, unlike its current release-only description, and no launcher release is listed.
highlights: The large source addition mostly imports existing decompilation trees, especially Going Commando and Deadlocked, rather than new player-facing features.
The Ratchet & Clank NTSC-U build works on an Apple Silicon Mac through the documented Wine 8 route, with the boot executable and level C checked.
Deadlocked's early checks compare functions with most immediate values masked and do not link them. The project documentation explicitly describes this as a weaker proof.
#1 proposes another Going Commando source update, including an isolated experimental PAL functional port. It remains unmerged, and that port claims no matching credit.
